description: Verify that the REBINDING retransmission interval is (lease - T2) / 2 (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
Same halving rule as RENEWING but applied to the remaining time after T2: retx at half of (lease_end - T2). The window keeps shrinking until lease expiry, when the client must give up and return to INIT.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew REQUEST.
3. T2 → REBINDING → rebind REQUEST #1.
4. Tester silent.
5. After (lease - T2)/2: DUT → wire: rebind REQUEST #2   ← key check

[Pass condition]
(t_REB#2 - t_REB#1) ≈ (lease - T2) / 2.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_retx_interval_out_of_bounds — retx interval outside the tolerance window.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_first_rebinding_request: No DUT first rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_second_rebinding_request: No DUT second rebinding DHCPREQUEST within retx window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_retx_interval_out_of_boun: DUT rebinding retx interval out of bounds
